mission.title: Bells and Bullets
mission.description: Track the stolen key through Achan and Camon Heights with a new tracking device.

phase.briefing: The data you provided, {player}, has enabled us to construct a device capable of tracking the stolen key anywhere in the Matrix. Agent Pace will supply you with the device.

enter.say: My scan is showing Agent Pace in there. Hm... I wonder if I can enhance the resolution...

objective.text: Get the tracking device from Agent Pace

talk.say: Benvenuto, rosapillore. I have the tracking device we were able to construct from the data you provided. Please, take it from me.

done.say: No need to thank me, tesoro. Find our missing key, and we will all be very grateful.

phase.briefing: {player}, you will begin your sweep with the tracking device in Achan, the last verified location of the stolen key.

enter.say:
All right, search through the area, and we'll see what the tracking device tells us. Make sure you don't skip any rooms until we get the data we need.
I'm picking up Bells activity in the area. I'm betting they aren't too happy about what happened in the last encounter.

objective.text: Sweep the first room with the tracker
Sweep the second room with the tracker

complete.say: Okey-doke, Gray tells me the tracker's picked something up. Get out to the street while I get him on the mike.

phase.briefing: {player}, your tracker has detected the key's trail, and it points in the direction of Camon Heights. Proceed to that neighborhood and initiate a second sweep.

enter.say:
You know the drill: check the rooms until the tracker picks up the key's code trail. The code scan shows a locked door in there, so you might have to find a key to it first.
And, uh, this probably doesn't come as a big surprise, but the local gang, the Bullets, seem to be homing in on you. You're not wearing that "Just say No to gangs!" T-shirt again, are you?

objective.text: Find the key to the locked door
Sweep the first room with the tracker
Sweep the locked room with the tracker

complete.say: Your tracker's picked up the key's trail again. You can get out of there.

phase.briefing: You're closing in on the key's location, {player}. Now it is only a matter of time.

enter.say: The device tracked the key's signal to that address. Scan's showing Exile programs infesting the area--but they aren't Bullet gang members, and they don't scan like normal Merv programs, either. Is someone else on the key's trail?

objective.text: Follow the key's trail with the tracker

done.say: Uh-oh, something just happened with the data we're getting from your tracker. Gray sounds pissed--relatively speaking, I mean. We'd better go see what the deal is.

mission.finish:
The key's code signature has disappeared from the tracker. This new development must be analyzed before we can continue with the retrieval operation. We have insufficient data at this time.
We will contact you when we have further need of you, {player}. That is all.
